notes: Chunk 16: 3 program-list, 0 single-record, 7 not-a-list. The two UW dissertation records are single-person pages but in humanities departments (Comparative Literature, Scandinavian Studies), so they are marked not-a-list rather than single-record. The UWM graduates page is the strongest find: its Supply Chain and Operations Management section lists 15 graduates 1985-2009 with dissertation, date, advisor and placement (some entries run together on one line, e.g. Zhu/Su/Ma and Wang/Zhang). The Yale alumni page mixes all SOM areas with no area labels and gives only a post-program affiliation per person (no job titles). The Yale job-market page lists candidates, not placements. The Swansea page's host maps to 'University of Wales'; it is a Swansea University page, but since it is not a list the institution was left as given.
